designationHistory.name: Las Vegas-Maxwell National Wildlife Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Maxwell's lands were acquired under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act as part of the combined Las Vegas-Maxwell National Wildlife Refuge in northeastern New Mexico.
designationHistory.note: FWS compatibility determinations give August 24, 1965 (same as Las Vegas); Maxwell became a separate refuge after July 27, 1966.

sources.name: FWS ServCat: Compatibility Determination, Fishing, Maxwell NWR (2006)
FWS ServCat: Las Vegas NWR CCP (2004): Las Vegas-Maxwell split July 27, 1966
